prospective_tests: Authenticate native EMC from actual source labels/primary validation, not a gene alias or generic chondrosarcoma transfer.
Identify the exact proposed measurement and condition unit, accessible linked data, controls, donor overlap and every eligible native EMC observation.
State the primary published claim and exact unanswered addition; source presence, corrected provenance or a null keyword search is not novelty.

State a consequential biological/descriptive use or actual experiment decision that different results can change. RNA evidence does not universally require protein validation, donor pairing or cell assignment.
Challenge strongest source-specific alternatives and freeze a result that defeats the proposed use before relevant outcomes where possible.
Distinguish published measurements without a deposit, suitable pending public evidence, unavailable source bodies, unsuited assay and genuinely evaluated negatives.
Use prior verified R1-R9 dispositions/exposures and independent omission reviews without rerunning unchanged failed questions or rescuing TMEM266/DLK1/old target panels.
decision_options: GO: one concrete bounded analysis with an actual useful question, linked units/controls, fixed inputs and defeat rule; root owns final scope and numerical authorization.
NO-GO: concrete source/identity/measurement/value failure, preserving favorable facts, eligible pending evidence and exact reopening condition.
Result reassessment, only if a genuinely authorized frozen outcome arrives: supported new useful empirical knowledge versus valid but insufficient value, with publication coverage limits separately.
source_selection: Zero-copy owner plans/primary method and identity extracts. No duplicate searches or downloads. Read an actual new proposal once frozen or a prospective question supplied before outcomes; do not invent a task for a missing candidate.
exposure: Historical GPNMB contrast/high exception and all R1-R9 failed/held questions are already exposed. No cold-discovery claim. Exact new field/outcome exposure will be recorded per lane.
omission_scope: Technical replicates and same-donor cross-assay duplication
